title: sparkxray capabilities
description: Everything a program driving sparkxray can call or read, as sparkxray capabilities show --json prints it. It is read from the running command and library: commands from the command tree, rules from the catalog, tables from the table registry, codes from the error registry. A field removed or a meaning changed raises schema_version, and a field added does not.

commands.description: Every command, in the order its help lists them.

rules.description: Every rule in the catalog, by id.

signals.description: What a log can hold that a rule reads. A rule whose signals the log lacks is skipped, naming them.

tables.description: Every table and view tables query reads. findings exists once the log is analyzed. sparkxray schemas show tables gives their columns.

schemas.description: Every name sparkxray schemas show takes.

error_codes.description: Every error code, retired ones included. sparkxray schemas show errors gives each one's exit code and when it is raised.

reads.description: False for a command that can write a file the caller names. Every command may write sparkxray's cache.

summary.description: The first paragraph of the command's help.

name.description: The argument as help shows it, as LOG.

exit_codes.description: What each exit status means for this command. sparkxray schemas show errors gives the status of each error code.

choices.description: The words a choice takes. Null for any other type.

multiple.description: Whether the flag repeats, one value each time.

default.description: What the command uses when the flag is left out. Null where it uses nothing, or a default its help describes.

rule_version.description: Raised when the rule judges differently, so a finding names the logic that made it.

signals.description: What a log must hold for the rule to run.

thresholds.description: What the rule judges by. --threshold <rule_id>.<name>=<value> overrides one, in its unit or with a unit suffix as 512MiB.

default.description: The value the rule uses unless overridden, in unit.
